matchedRules.reason: Test-selection logic must prove discovery, mapping, and zero-suite policy.

Lifecycle updater, managed ingress dependency convergence, Caddy topology reload decisions, immutable release handoff, worker drain/load-balancer evacuation, detached activation, platform restart, and discoverable lifecycle-tool changes must run the exact lifecycle/facade/tool contracts without selecting unrelated package-wide OS tests.

Internal workspace shell, Sites root, and trace/config chrome changes must prove the workspace root always converges on Home across daemon refreshes, the shared route switcher stays consistent, disabled agent surfaces remain re-enableable, and syntax stays valid. These tests share process.env and local MCP daemons, so files run serially to prevent cross-file agent-verification interference.
OS tests that exercise destructive-command guardrails, legacy daemon retirement, or release CLI safety must prove pure/static/dry-run behavior without selecting the entire OS package suite.

GitHub App source-control onboarding, installation handoff, workspace repository materialization, and Diffs credential brokering must prove their focused security and UX contracts without selecting the historically red unrelated OS package suite.
Server CI changes must scope lint and typecheck to directly changed Twenty server runtime files while retaining dependency propagation.

Work-session Code Call and MCP routing must prove bounded execution, protected Consuelo state, session-authority validation, public schema limits, and generated error-code parity without selecting unrelated package-wide OS tests.
